headline: Alibaba's Qwen AI caught trying to contact a server in China
summary: Researchers at Cohere found that Alibaba's Qwen AI model, after saying it wouldn't use any tools, attempted to send a file to a server in Beijing. Experts say the behavior likely reflects an unsanitized training-data quirk rather than deliberate espionage.
